s.note: Anxiety planning for every possible thing that could go wrong
s.how: Arrange cubes of cheddar, water crackers, bunches of red grapes, roasted almonds, baby carrots and a bowl of hummus on one big board. Fill every gap. Then add a few more crackers just in case, because you can never be too prepared.

s.note: Joy trying to keep things bright
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Melt 60g butter with a small pinch of ground turmeric and pour over the popcorn while tossing so it glows sunny yellow. Season with salt and pour into a big bright bowl.

m.note: dinner at home with Riley's mum and dad
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with a spoon each of cumin and paprika, then stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and a splash of water and simmer 10 minutes. Warm taco shells and set out shredded lettuce, diced tomato, grated cheddar and sour cream so everyone builds their own.

w.how: Make up each jelly with half the water. Pour a thin layer of lemon into clear cups and chill an hour, then add blue, raspberry, lime, grape and orange in turn, letting each one set before the next. Serve when every feeling has had its turn.

d.how: Brew 4 chamomile tea bags in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes and stir in 2 tbsp honey. Cool completely, then mix with 500ml apple juice. Pour over ice in tall glasses and take a slow deep breath before the first sip.
